svg.text: bias_tree_rb: the lines ni / vbp / vbnc of both replica blocks, shared in pad_ref_rb
bias_tree_rb: the lines of both replica blocks, as bias_tree_pd at the pad devices' current densities.
ni = NI, 6u/6u NMOS diode carrying the reference (= the pads' BN density: 5 uA in 6u/6u)
vbp = BP, 2u/6u PMOS diode at 2 uA from NBP 2.4u/6u (= the pads' BP density: 5 uA in 5u/6u)
vbnc = BNC, 1u/8u NMOS diode at 2 uA from PBNC 2u/6u (= the pads' BNC)
Disabled (en_3v3 = 0): TGN / TGP open the reference, TDN pulls ni to vss; BP pulls vbp to vdd, BNC vbnc to vss.
TGP: drain ni, source iref as drawn by Christoph (2026-11-07, b4cd2288); a transmission gate is symmetric.
drawn from netlist/source/pad_ref_rb.spice (subckt bias_tree_rb); cut from vref_s2d_rb.sch as Christoph drew it (d0638017)
[3] layout dummies, NMOS tree row (on vss)
